    Hybrid Search Scoring (RRF) - Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search)

    Nov 17, 2026 · Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) is an algorithm that evaluates search scores from multiple previously ranked results to produce a single, unified result set. In Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search), RRF is used when two or more queries execute in parallel, such as hybrid queries and multiple vector queries.
